answer: Yes. The tractor’s headlights becoming “zwei gelben Augen” and the fog erasing both shores turn the ordinary crossing into an evocative image of isolation and uncertainty, echoing Ilse’s reluctance to confront Jonas’s call and her future. Regional, understated dialogue—particularly “Suppe heute” for the fog and “Dein Wort in Gottes Ohr”—also lends authenticity to the characters without disrupting the restrained narration.
